ruling: Traced 2026-10-30 after a committee report that the sheet and site disagree. ASSUMPTION: the two swaps execute in the order they were traded, as League office memo 2026-01 ruled for the c28 chain. Trade 23 (2021-08-02) gave ORL the better of ORL/WAS, so WAS keeps the worse of ORL/WAS. Trade 43 (2022-07-30) gave ORL the 'More Favorable of 28 ORL/MIL 1st'; by then ORL held only the better of ORL/WAS, so that is what was swapped against MIL, and MIL keeps the worse of MIL and ORL's post-swap pick. The sheet's WAS tab agrees with this; its MIL tab ('less favorable of MIL and ORL') reads ORL's own pick literally and is taken to mean ORL's pick after its WAS swap. The earlier seed (curated.py, 2026-07-19) ran the MIL swap first and cited no trade for it. The two readings differ only when ORL's own pick is the worst of the three: it now goes to WAS, not MIL.
